title: Read without changing data
summary: REST API Development: Read without changing data. Write the response for a collection with two books.
introduction: GET asks to read a resource. Reading this collection does not add or remove books.
learningObjectives: Read without changing data with REST API Development
Write the response for a collection with two books

blocks.text: Read the request and response pairs in a text editor. They show only headers useful to each idea. No server, account or installation is needed for these exercises; /books is an imaginary practice API.

blocks.title: Read without changing data
blocks.code:
GET /books HTTP/1.1
Host: example.test

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

[{"id":1,"title":"Moon Trip"}]

blocks.text: The collection URL returns an array. The worked response contains one resource in that array.

blocks.title: Expected result
blocks.content: A list with one book is returned.

blocks.text: Write the response for a collection with two books.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not design a GET route that deletes a record.
